title: Yochanan ben Beteira, a Tanna
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Hyman cites Zevachim 23a for him, but reports that Dikdukei Soferim and Shitah Mekubetzet read Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira, as in [Menachot 8b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.8b.18). [Menachot 41b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.41b.16) says that the elders of Beit Shammai and Beit Hillel went up to Yochanan ben Beteira’s upper room; Hyman reports Yonatan in Shitah Mekubetzet and [Sifrei Shelach](https://www.sefaria.org/Sifrei_Bamidbar.115.1).[^3]

notes.text: Yehudah, Yochanan and Yonatan ben Beteira are the readings attributed to the cited witnesses. The upper room is connected with the named host, not with a new reporting authority.

The consulted Menachot 41b reads Yochanan ben Beteira; the bounded opening of Sifrei Bamidbar 115 reads Yonatan ben Beteira. The exact Dikdukei Soferim and Shitah Mekubetzet readings were not independently inspected and remain Hyman’s report.

[Zevachim 63a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.63a.15) explicitly reads Yochanan ben Beteira in the parallel about eating offerings when non-Jews surround the courtyard. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1810&lang=en) cites this folio, compares Yehudah in Menachot 8b, and records Yonatan for the upper-room account in Sifrei. Hyman’s Zevachim 23a locator remains as supplied.
